title: [R10] Audit permanent circuit lower bounds
acceptance: Map theorem model, characteristic, uniformity and relation to structured families; cite independently checked statements.

title: [R11] Compare subexponential SAT approaches
acceptance: Compare reductions, hidden constants, arithmetic vs bit cost; verify sources before relying on claims.

title: [R12] Weighted quotient graphs
acceptance: Define endpoint-fixed weighted XOR walk semantics and validate signed examples.

title: [R13] Möbius inversion aggregation
acceptance: Exact signed tests and direct oracle; preserve quotient multiplicities; test actual R9 transfer later.

title: [R14] Graph width and contraction complexity
acceptance: Measure treewidth/cut width and actual contraction work, not only label counts.

title: [R15] Cross-pattern graph reuse
acceptance: Aggregate graph weights across patterns; prove equivalence and cost.

title: [R16] Finite Fourier construction review
acceptance: Verify theorem, explicit algorithm and crossover; compare with Walsh baseline.

title: [R17] Fourier over prime-power rings
acceptance: Prove ring-compatible operations or show counterexamples; exact transform results.

title: [R18] Sunflower-style grouping
acceptance: Test weighted common-core identities, preserve signs, orders and multiplicity.

title: [R19] Valuation-aware exact arithmetic
acceptance: Known-divisible quotient precision checks, nonintegral cancellation and sound guard digits.

title: [R20] Truncated permanent polynomials
acceptance: Compare all orders with direct signed rational oracle; target repeated minors.

title: [R21] Modular Hermite interpolation
acceptance: Identify admissible moduli, denominators and interpolation uniqueness.

title: [R22] Final count CRT
acceptance: Reconstruct unique count from pairwise coprime residues; test end-to-end reduction and bad moduli.

title: [R23] Asymmetric SAT-derived matrices
acceptance: Generate genuine signed reductions and compare with known counts.

title: [R24] Independent Lean specifications
acceptance: Freeze theorem statement, toolchain and assumptions before proof generation.

title: [R25] Formalize exact identities
acceptance: No sorry/admitted proofs; audit axioms and independent statements.

title: [R26] Proof compression
acceptance: Compare theorem-equivalent developments, audit assumptions and resources.

title: [R27] Full asymptotic bound
acceptance: Account for all nodes, orders, arithmetic bit lengths and sparsification; no inference from finite results.

title: [R28] End-to-end SAT benchmarks
acceptance: Compare matched baselines, difficult SAT/UNSAT, time and memory; preserve null results.

title: [R29] Reproducible research publication
acceptance: Rights approval, versioned source and evidence, independent replay and limited claims.
